_comments: Cloning configuration for MJ: Users — Onboard a user like Alice with same roles, apps, and settings, inactive, owner-only.
User Settings are Skip by default (RK review): they hold push-device tokens, drafts and consent. The with-settings preset copies the rest.

Presets.Label: Include personal settings
Presets.Description: Copies the source user's layout and preference settings. Device tokens, chat drafts, recording consent and recent-item history are never copied.

UI.Label: Clone user
UI.ConfirmationMessage: The new user is created inactive and must be activated after review.
